cr_data.provenance: (An American Place, New York, NY); (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Private collection, Meriden, Connecticut, 1947; The artist, purchase, 1961; (Robert Miller Gallery, Inc., New York, NY); James Maroney, Inc., New York, NY, and William Beadelston, Inc., New York, NY, 1979 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March, 1946. . . . No signature" On backing: In pencil by O'Keeffe "City Night – 26" . . . July 1949 [not verified]. Miss Bry (An Amer. Place) told me that this picture had been bought by the Miller Co, a lighting fixture firm in Conn. The Miller Co. used the color reproduction as their Christmas card in 1947." History of extensive conservation is recorded and available in museum files. Mentioned in *New York Times* (January 1932) as being at Reinhardt Galleries. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: City Night

description: Massive, featureless black and gray skyscrapers, seen from below, rise through the canvas. Shorter white skyscrapers appear in the distance. A strip of blue night sky cuts through the center of the composition, and a white lamp glows brightly at the bottom of the work.
imageCaption: Image has not been color proofed to current standards, and its colors may differ from the original work. The Museum will replace it when new photography becomes available.
